items.passage: Sophia loves traveling. She has visited many countries with her family. She has been to Japan twice and has eaten many kinds of sushi. She has never been to Europe, but she really wants to go. Last year, she started a travel blog. She has already written thirty posts. Her dream is to visit every continent before she is thirty.
items.advPassage: Daniel has just moved to a new city. He has already made a few friends at school, but he hasn't joined any clubs yet. He has always loved playing the guitar, so he plans to start a band. He has never performed on a stage before, and he feels both excited and nervous. His family has supported him, and they have promised to come to his first show.
